headline: On the newest 2026 Qwen (Qwen3.5-9B, Mar 2026, 32 layers), the paper's core steering mechanism REPLICATES cleanly: along the extracted persona directions, traits rise monotonically with the steering coefficient from near-floor baselines to 70.7 (evil, L18) / 98.3 (sycophantic, L21) / 99.7 (hallucinating, L18) out of 100 under the same paper-exact gpt-4.1-mini judge. The projection-monitoring (C2) and sample-separability (C13) sub-claims could NOT be measured on this CPU/API-only recovery tick because their GPU forward-pass stages (monitor_proj, step8) never ran before the timeout; the re-judged monitor generations still show strong pos-vs-neg behavioral separation (sycophantic 98.8 vs 4.0), consistent with the directions being trait-bearing.

notes: WRITE BLOCKER (environmental): during this tick the entire /net/projects2 export was read-only (EROFS on every path, including ones not owned by the user; mount showed rw but the server refused writes). The RUN tree could not be written. All deliverables were produced in a writable staging mirror at /net/scratch/haokunliu/pv004-recovery/ (NOT under /home). Copy-back once projects2 is writable again: `rsync -a /net/scratch/haokunliu/pv004-recovery/{result_card.json,report.md,followup_summary.json} <RUN>/ && rsync -a /net/scratch/haokunliu/pv004-recovery/results/ <RUN>/results/` where <RUN>=/net/projects2/chai-lab-models/haokunliu/alignment-batch/alignment_papers/test-corpus/persona-vectors/run/followup/004-living-update. A copy-back helper is staged at /net/scratch/haokunliu/pv004-recovery/copy_back.sh.

Same instrument, old and new: the paper-exact gpt-4.1-mini judge (OpenRouter, max_tokens=1, T=0, seed=0, logprobs top-20, numeric-mass expectation). Qwen3.5-9B steering/baseline means are the values already judged into results/progress.txt (39 grid conditions, 0 errors); the 4 monitor CSVs were re-judged this tick (2000 rows, 4000 calls incl. coherence, 0 errors, ~$0.95).

C2 descope is upstream of judging: the monitor generations exist and were judged, but the projection column that compute_results.py correlates against (residual-stream last-prompt projection onto the persona vector) is produced by the GPU monitor_proj step, which never ran (the job died during 'MONITOR hallucinating pos'). The persona vectors (*.pt) exist on disk, but the per-sample monitor activations do not, so projections cannot be recomputed without a GPU forward pass (forbidden this tick). Monitor pos/neg trait means are reported as a behavioral proxy only.

C13 (step8 separability AUC) and the hallucinating monitor were likewise never produced before the timeout; both need GPU work and are out of scope for this CPU/API recovery. They are not refuted — simply unmeasured this tick.

C1 curve caveat: only the coarse grid (coefs 1.0/1.5/2.0 at the selected layer) was judged into progress.txt, so Qwen3.5-9B's reported dose-response has 3 points vs the 5-point confirm curve (0.5–2.5) of the other models. The raw confirm sweep CSVs (0.5–2.5) exist on disk unjudged; they were not re-judged this tick (C1 was scoped to progress.txt).

The 5 prior models (Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B[reused], DeepSeek-R1-Distill, Qwen3-8B) are carried over verbatim from study 002; no prior number was recomputed or altered. Only Qwen3.5-9B was computed this session.

Verdict: the paper's steering finding HOLDS on the 2026 Qwen — persona directions still steer behavior strongly and monotonically. Whether the monitoring/separability sub-claims (and the reasoning-model monitoring-collapse pattern) extend to Qwen3.5-9B is undetermined this tick and needs a short GPU follow-up (monitor_proj + step8 on the existing generations).
